name: status-placeholder
description: Vite development environment for MVU Status Bar

scripts.build:mvu: cross-env BUILD_TARGET=mvu vite build && cross-env BUILD_TARGET=mvu node scripts/build-post.js && cross-env BUILD_TARGET=mvu node scripts/validate-build.js && pnpm run prune:dist
scripts.build:shujuku: cross-env BUILD_TARGET=shujuku vite build && cross-env BUILD_TARGET=shujuku node scripts/build-post.js && cross-env BUILD_TARGET=shujuku node scripts/validate-build.js && pnpm run prune:dist
scripts.build:floating-mvu: cross-env BUILD_TARGET=floating vite build && cross-env BUILD_TARGET=floating node scripts/build-floating-mvu.js && cross-env BUILD_TARGET=floating node scripts/validate-floating-mvu.js && pnpm run prune:dist
scripts.build:all: pnpm run build:mvu && pnpm run build:shujuku && pnpm run build:floating-mvu
scripts.validate:adapters: cross-env BUILD_TARGET=shujuku node scripts/validate-build.js --source-only && cross-env BUILD_TARGET=floating node scripts/validate-floating-mvu.js --source-only && node scripts/validate-character-lore.js
